Welcome to Monkey Tree Montessori Preschool Inc. We offer an enriched preschool program for children 2½–6 yrs. Monkey Tree Montessori Preschool is an environment where children's educational, physical and emotional needs are met.

Children have the freedom to learn at their own pace with no competition or external rewards — therefore developing self creation during their formative years of life.
